english.title: Cause use of m/v - fail to maintain lamp / reflector / rear marking / device
english.standardoffencewording:

english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 23(1) of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
cause the use of a motor vehicle on a road
when not every front lamp / rear position / headlamp / rear registration plate lamp OR
side marker lamp / end-outline marker lamp / rear fog lamp OR
retro reflector / stop lamp / direction indicator lamp / running lamp OR
dim dip device / headlamp levelling device / hazard warning signal device
was not in good working order/not clean

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
